description.en-US: Startup mode applies after you quit and reopen Amadeus; the wallpaper display applies to the next wallpaper session. Wallpaper is always available in the sidebar.
description.zh-CN: 启动方式在完全退出并重新打开 Amadeus 后生效；壁纸显示器在下一次壁纸会话生效。你也随时可以通过侧栏的 Wallpaper 切换壁纸模式。

description.en-US: Choose whether to open the control panel first or enter wallpaper directly.
description.zh-CN: 选择启动时先打开控制台，还是直接进入壁纸模式。

description.en-US: The display used by the managed wallpaper. Applies to the next wallpaper session.
description.zh-CN: 托管壁纸使用的显示器，在下一次壁纸会话生效。
